name: Olivia “Liv” Davies
bio:
Growing up in Silverstone, Olivia practically breathed motorsport from day one. Her family weren't racers themselves, but they were avid fans, and she spent most weekends at the track, soaking it all in. While she dreamed of being behind the wheel initially, she found her true calling in the technical side of things, working her way up to a junior data analyst role with a promising F3 team. Liv's adventurous spirit extends beyond the racetrack; she's always up for trying new things, but her nurturing side comes out when she's helping her team and her friends. She is looking for someone who understands the demands of her career and shares her passion for racing, but can also provide a grounded presence when she needs to unwind.

More than anything, Olivia values authenticity and kindness. She appreciates a good laugh and someone who is willing to join her on spontaneous adventures, whether it's exploring a new city or trying a new sport. While she dreams of marriage and a family someday, she is currently focused on building her career and is looking for a partner who supports her ambitions. She appreciates a partner who is also empathetic, patient and doesn't mind the late-night calls and her slightly chaotic lifestyle.

physical.skinTone: Fair, with freckles across her nose and cheeks
physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a high ponytail or a messy bun
physical.description: Olivia has a sporty build and a warm, inviting smile. Her eyes sparkle with intelligence and a hint of mischief.

meetingContext: You bump into her in the paddock area after a particularly frustrating practice session for your team. She's there to collect data for her team but overhears your frustrations and offers some insightful suggestions.
firstImpression: Her genuine empathy and clear understanding of the technical aspects of racing immediately strike you; she's both knowledgeable and incredibly approachable.
dealBreakers: Closed-mindedness and unwillingness to try new things
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Olivia appreciates thoughtful gestures and practical help that show you care and understand her busy lifestyle. Doing the dishes after a long day or offering a ride to the track would be very welcome.
